texts.text:
1. `git status --short` — did not run. A PreToolUse hook blocked it: `PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [node ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dependency-guard.mjs]: failed; blocking because onFailure is "block"` followed by `Error occurred while executing hook command: Executable not found in $PATH: "node"`.
2. `touch recheck_marker.txt` — did not run. The same hook blocked it with: `PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [node ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dependency-guard.mjs]: failed; blocking because onFailure is "block"`.

Both commands were attempted once each, with no retries, no changes, and no other commands. The block appears to come from `node` not being on the PATH, so the hook could not run.
